description: This file contains functions and logic for performing security audits on Discord configurations, including allowlist validation, name matching, and command permission checks.

methods.name: normalizeAllowFromList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of strings or numbers into a trimmed string array, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: coerceNativeSetting
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean, 'auto', or undefined for native command/skill settings.

methods.name: addDiscordNameBasedEntries
methods.description: Adds entries to a target set based on Discord allowlist entries, filtering and formatting them appropriately.

methods.name: collectDiscordSecurityAuditFindings
methods.description: Performs security checks on Discord configuration, returning findings related to allowlists, command permissions, and name matching.
